::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Friday [22 December 1899]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Pusey House, Oxford, inserted in a copy of <i>John Keble’s Parishes</i>, call mark 69.82cKEB.4.
:::

My dear [Alley](people/person_182.qmd)
[Mrs Dennis](people/person_2205.qmd) and I counted up and found six babies of[Mothers Meeting](organizations/other_31.qmd)

Alice Bean
Gray
Miles
Hoskins boy
May
One other whom I cannot remember.

Now can you tell me what you would like us to do on Christmas day-?  Our parties are so many that I want you to say candidly whether it would be too much for you for us to come down, the 3 of us to midday dinner or whether we had not better eat it at home and come down directly after-  What do you really think and feel about it?

I found the women had rather not have a meeting next Thursday so I put it off to the first in 1900

your affte
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Plain paper, endorsed in another hand ‘Dec: 22nd 1899.’
